_doc: MUSIC.md v3 (E33): every MiniMax Music 3 job, keyed <group>/<name>. gen_minimax.py --jobs v3-jobs.json --keys ... renders them; takes land in <out>/<group>-<name>/minimax3-<seed>.wav. Music slots ask for a steady drums + bass groove under the whole piece so demucs can lift it out as the tension layer, and for no fade-out so the loop body stays full. MiniMax ignores key and tempo (round 1), so BPM/key here are requests; the shipped grid comes from beat-tracking. Sound effects are not MiniMax's job (the user, 2026-09-22: MiniMax is music only) - see sfx-jobs.json / gen_sfx.py. The sting-* jobs were rendered (4 seeds x 9) but not used: MiniMax filled all 6 s with mid-song band music (no silence after the gesture, and CLAP heard folk in most piano/orchestral ones), so stems.py cuts the stings from each style's own takes instead.

piano/pine.prompt: Genre: video game soundtrack, ambient piano with a gentle groove. BPM: 88. Key: D major. Instrumental only, no vocals, no choir. Setting: Pine Hollow, a misty pine forest at dawn in an open-world adventure game - wonder first, quiet adventure second, a little melancholy underneath. Arrangement: a sparse, singable grand-piano melody with long rests, over soft string pads and a warm upright bass; a light, steady groove of brushed drums, soft kick and shaker runs under the whole piece from the second bar to the end. No fade-out: the last bar is as full as the rest. Production: close-miked felt piano, natural wooden-room reverb.

piano/island.prompt: Genre: video game soundtrack, bright ambient piano with a light groove. BPM: 100. Key: D major. Instrumental only, no vocals, no choir. Setting: Driftwood Isle, a sunlit island of pale sand, driftwood and turquoise water in an open-world adventure game - wonder first, breezy adventure second, a little melancholy underneath. Arrangement: a sparkling, singable grand-piano melody in the upper register with open fifths, over airy pads, a round electric bass and a soft marimba ostinato; a steady light groove of rim clicks, shaker and soft kick runs under the whole piece from the second bar to the end. No fade-out: the last bar is as full as the rest. Production: bright piano, wide airy reverb.

piano/title.prompt: Genre: video game main title theme, cinematic piano. BPM: 92. Key: D major. Instrumental only, no vocals, no choir.
